case_study.review_text: This restoration company was able to take our weather related water intrusion job from start to finish within a very reasonable timeframe. The people we worked with communicated their next steps and asked questions when needed. The construction manager was always super quick to respond to my questions or concerns. It was obvious that their goal was to get the job done correctly to our satisfaction and they achieved that goal. The work was done well.  Perhaps most importantly, at all times everyone treated us kindly and respectfully, which made an experience that we didn't ask for or want  just a bit more pleasant. In the end, a wonderful crew of two women came in to help me get the house clean from top to bottom which was an unexpected bonus! If I'd ever need it, I'd definitely hire DISS Restoration again.
